title: Plant growth
goal: Compare seedlings under controlled light conditions.
explain: Compare two light settings while holding water constant. Index values illustrate a model, not actual centimetres.

title: Water filtration
goal: Build a filter and compare the visible suspended particles.
explain: Explain why removing visible particles does not prove water is safe to drink.

title: Circuit construction
goal: Connect a low-voltage battery, lamp and switch.
explain: Use I = V/R with a fixed 10 ohm lamp. Opening the switch breaks the circuit.

title: Heat transfer
goal: Compare energy transfer through a model conducting rod.
explain: Explain transfer from hotter to cooler regions. The model is lumped heating, not a full convection simulation.

title: First aid response
goal: Assess a virtual emergency scenario and explain the safe next action.
explain: Scenario 1: unresponsive but breathing normally in a safe place — get help and follow trained recovery-position guidance. Scenario 2: a dangerous scene — stay clear and call for help. Scenario 3: unresponsive and not breathing normally — call 112/999, seek an AED and trained resuscitation help immediately. This model does not certify first-aid skills.

title: Balanced meal
goal: Assemble a model meal and compare its energy contribution.
explain: Compare portions and discuss variety. This energy-only model is not an individual dietary prescription.

title: Water testing
goal: Measure a water sample with a model pH probe.
explain: pH alone cannot establish potability; explain what microbiological testing would add.

title: Acids and bases
goal: Add indicator and compare acidic and alkaline samples.
explain: Use indicator colour to classify the sample. This is classification, not a quantitative titration.

title: Body systems
goal: Locate organs and trace the flow of oxygenated blood.
explain: Explain how breathing and circulation work together. Cardiac output assumes a fixed 70 mL stroke volume.

title: Simple machines
goal: Place a load and change the effort-arm length.
explain: Balance moments: effort × effort arm = 10 N × 0.5 m, ignoring friction and beam mass.

title: Electromagnets
goal: Wind a coil and use current to lift model iron pieces.
explain: Compare N × I at a fixed 0.5 A. This is magnetising force, not a prediction of lifting mass.

title: Microscope
goal: Place a slide, focus and change magnification.
explain: Total magnification = 10× eyepiece × objective. The specimen is a schematic cell representation.

title: Digestion
goal: Trace food through the main digestive organs.
explain: Distinguish mechanical digestion, chemical digestion and absorption; stage numbers are not elapsed time.

title: Weather station
goal: Site instruments and record a model weather reading.
explain: Explain consistent siting and recording time. The selected readings are inputs, not a weather forecast.

title: Inheritance
goal: Cross two heterozygous parent models and compare expected offspring.
explain: Aa × Aa gives AA:Aa:aa = 1:2:1; expected dominant phenotype is 75%, not a guarantee for a small family.

title: DNA model
goal: Assemble complementary bases on a double-helix model.
explain: A–T has two hydrogen bonds and G–C has three; the model uses alternating pairs.

title: Chemical bonds
goal: Build a molecule from atoms and inspect its bonds.
explain: A neutral water model uses two O–H bonds. Other settings show incomplete or invalid assemblies, not new stable molecules.

title: Wave interference
goal: Switch on two wave sources and compare superposition.
explain: For equal unit-amplitude waves, resultant amplitude is 2|cos(phase/2)| at equal path length.

title: Ecosystem balance
goal: Change starting prey population and observe one model time step.
explain: A discrete teaching model combines prey reproduction and predation; it is not a field population forecast.

title: Electrolysis
goal: Place electrodes in an aqueous teaching cell and switch on low voltage.
explain: Water electrolysis produces hydrogen and oxygen in a 2:1 volume ratio in this ideal cell. Relative gas units are illustrative.

title: Greenhouse effect
goal: Compare a simple radiative-forcing model at different carbon dioxide levels.
explain: Use ΔF = 5.35 ln(C/280). This is radiative forcing, not temperature or a local climate forecast.

title: Cell division
goal: Sequence chromosome separation in a model cell.
explain: Compare chromosome movement across stages. This schematic shows mitotic separation; explain how meiosis differs.

title: Enzyme activity
goal: Place enzyme and substrate in a temperature-controlled bath.
explain: Compare activity around a notional 37 °C optimum. The curve is an illustrative approximation, not measured enzyme data.

title: DNA extraction
goal: Carry out a schematic sample preparation and precipitation sequence.
explain: Explain membrane disruption and DNA precipitation. Relative yield is illustrative and does not predict a real extraction.

title: Photosynthesis
goal: Compare a water-plant model at controlled light levels.
explain: Rate saturates as light increases when another factor limits it. Values are relative teaching units.

title: Respiration
goal: Operate a lung model and compare ventilation.
explain: Minute ventilation = 0.5 L tidal volume × breathing rate; this is not an individual lung-function test.

title: Ecosystem dynamics
goal: Compare prey abundance in a fixed predator model.
explain: Use the discrete model to discuss interactions and identify missing environmental factors.

title: PCR cycles
goal: Load a model tube and run an ideal amplification cycle.
explain: Ideal doubling gives 2ⁿ copies from one molecule; real amplification efficiency and contamination are omitted.

title: Gel electrophoresis
goal: Load a sample and run a model gel.
explain: Smaller fragments travel farther in this schematic. Relative distance is not calibrated for a real gel.

title: Organic molecules
goal: Assemble a carbon backbone and count hydrogens for an alkane.
explain: For an acyclic alkane, CₙH₂ₙ₊₂. The ball-and-stick representation is schematic, not a molecular-energy solver.

title: Electrochemical cell
goal: Connect electrodes and compare transferred charge.
explain: Charge Q = It. Distinguish externally driven electrolysis from a galvanic cell.

title: Reaction rates
goal: Mix reactants and compare a notional concentration-dependent rate.
explain: This model assumes first-order dependence on concentration; experimental rate laws must be determined from evidence.

title: Emission spectra
goal: Excite a model element and compare emitted photon energy.
explain: E = hc/λ. A chosen single wavelength is not a complete element-identification spectrum.

title: Polymer assembly
goal: Join monomer units into a chain.
explain: Distinguish monomer count from polymer properties; this model does not predict strength or reaction conditions.

title: Chromatography
goal: Spot paper and develop a model chromatogram.
explain: Rf = spot travel/solvent-front travel. A fixed model solute has Rf 0.60; compare distances at different front positions.

title: Calorimetry
goal: Insulate a model cup and measure water heating.
explain: Use ΔT = Q/(mc), m=100 g and c=4.18 J/g/°C. Heat losses and cup heat capacity are omitted.

title: Projectile motion
goal: Set a launcher and measure ideal horizontal range.
explain: R = v²sin(2θ)/g for 10 m/s, level launch/landing and no drag.

title: Pendulum
goal: Attach a bob, release it and compare the ideal period.
explain: T = 2π√(L/g), g=9.81 m/s². Mass does not affect this small-angle model.

title: Lens bench
goal: Align an object, converging lens and screen.
explain: Use 1/f = 1/u + 1/v with f=10 cm and u>f; the ray model is paraxial.

title: Wave superposition
goal: Align two coherent sources and compare phase.
explain: At equal path length, equal waves sum to 2|cos(phase/2)| times one wave amplitude.

title: Circuit analysis
goal: Wire a model resistor circuit and compare voltage/current.
explain: Use a fixed 10 ohm resistor. This module explores resistive DC circuits, not capacitor transients.

title: Electromagnetic induction
goal: Move a magnet through a coil and compare induced EMF.
explain: Magnitude scales with rate of flux change. Relative EMF is illustrative; polarity reverses with motion.

title: Radioactive decay
goal: Compare remaining nuclei after a chosen number of half-lives.
explain: N = 1000 × 2⁻ⁿ is an expectation. Real decay is random; no radioactive material is used.

title: Photoelectric effect
goal: Illuminate a surface and compare photon energy with its work function.
explain: Kmax = max(0,hf−φ), h=0.4135667696 eV per 10¹⁴ Hz. Brightness cannot overcome the frequency threshold.

title: Soil testing
goal: Collect a model sample and measure pH.
explain: Describe why crop-specific nutrient advice and representative sampling are needed beyond a pH reading.

title: Hydroponics
goal: Assemble a grow channel and compare solution pH.
explain: The availability curve is an illustrative index centred at pH 6, not crop-specific advice or a yield prediction.

title: Greenhouse control
goal: Position a sensor and adjust a model greenhouse temperature.
explain: A notional optimum of 24 °C is used to practise control and comparison; real crops differ.

title: Livestock care
goal: Compare a model feed allocation and record a daily plan.
explain: Total feed = ration × 5. This is arithmetic practice, not a species-specific feeding recommendation.

title: Network topology
goal: Connect computers to a switch and test the local simulated network.
explain: A star topology needs one link per workstation. All devices are simulated; no external hosts are contacted.

title: Cybersecurity
goal: Observe a simulated intrusion, enable a defence and compare event logs.
explain: Compare open-service, repeated-sign-in and suspicious-attachment scenarios. The security gateway represents the matching service rule, sign-in rate limit or attachment filter. This is a contained state model, not real malware or an attack against a network.

title: Database design
goal: Build two table models and link a learner key to a result table.
explain: Explain primary and foreign keys and why orphan result rows should be rejected. This relational model does not run SQL.

title: Sorting algorithms
goal: Arrange a model array and step through bubble-sort comparisons.
explain: A reverse-order bubble sort makes n(n−1)/2 comparisons in the unoptimised triangular-pass model.

title: Flight principles
goal: Position a wing model and compare lift at different airspeeds.
explain: L = 0.5ρv²SCL, with ρ=1.225, S=1 m², CL=0.5 fixed. Stall, drag and navigation are outside this model.

title: Building design
goal: Place structural components on a grid, rotate them and test a load model.
explain: For a symmetric ideal two-support beam each reaction is half the total load. This is a learning model, not structural approval.

title: Electrical workshop
goal: Assemble and fault-check a model low-voltage installation.
explain: Use I=V/10. Physical school extensions must use approved low-voltage equipment; never practise on mains wiring.

title: Automotive diagnostics
goal: Inspect a model vehicle battery circuit and read a diagnostic value.
explain: Compare resting voltage; one voltage reading cannot establish battery health or diagnose an engine fault.

title: Volcano model
goal: Inspect a volcano cross-section and compare a schematic pressure index.
explain: This schematic illustrates gas pressure and release. It does not forecast eruptions or simulate magma rheology.
